title.narrative: COVID-19: Responsive COVID-19 Vaccines for Recovery Project under the Asia Pacific Vaccine Access Facility

description.narrative: The project will support the procurement and delivery of safe and effective vaccines against COVID-19 through APVAX's RRC in compliance with ADB's vaccine eligibility criteria to the country. It aims to finance the procurement of about 15.9 million doses of vaccines, which will be administered to about 6.8 million Nepalese by 2024, with data collected and disaggregated by sex and age.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Safe and effective COVID-19 vaccines delivered Indicator: (Under TA support) All (100%) of the vaccination sites or outreach centers have at least one female health worker or volunteer supporting vaccination during the vaccination campaign. Achievement: Y Progress/Status: On an average, 93.64% of COVID-19 vaccination sessions conducted on 01 June 2022 in 12 local levels had at least one female health workers/volunteers present on site. Similarly, 92.75% of COVID-19 vaccination sessions conducted between 25 February and 23 August 2022 in 22 local levels had at least one female health workers/volunteers present on site.
(Source: Verification of the presence of female health worker or volunteer in COVID-19 vaccination sessions in Nepal to provide a gender-friendly and safe environment, November 2022 by ADB and WB in coordination with MoHP and DOHS-FWD)
Data Source: MOHP report. Survey report. Actual value: Y

Output: Safe and effective COVID-19 vaccines delivered Indicator: By 2024, about 15.9 million doses of COVID-19 vaccine procured and delivered to the country. Achievement: 5464000 Progress/Status: Procured 12.60 doses of vaccines (79.25% of total target) from ADB financing (5,936,400 direct procurement and 6,664,738 retroactive financing). 99.36 percent of total received vaccines have been delivered to all provinces. 7.52 percent received vaccines are in stock and stored in the cold chain. Data Source: Electronic logistic management information system, and MOHP project progress report.

Output: Safe and effective COVID-19 vaccines delivered Indicator: By 2023, level of awareness of the population on risks of COVID-19 and the benefits of vaccination increased (with data disaggregated by sex, age group, caste, and ethnic groups, and disability). Achievement: Y Progress/Status: ADB has hired a firm to conduct a study to assess the awareness of the risks of COVID-19 and the benefits of vaccination among the people as agreed in the mission conducted from 2 February to 2 March 2023. As per the UNICEF children and family tracker survey of November 2022, more than 98% of the respondents were willing to take the COVID-19 vaccine if available, and 93% of people are aware of the risk of COVID-19. Baseline data and the disaggregated progress update data are not available. A separate study is proposed. Data Source: Pre and post perception survey. UNICEF and MOHP reports. Baseline year: 2021 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2021 Baseline value: N Target year: 2023 Target value: Y Actual value: Y
Target populations safely vaccinated against COVID-19

About 6.8 million Nepalis (22.3% of the population) vaccinated against COVID-19 based on the national vaccination plan. Achievement: 6160000 Progress/Status: 6.16 million people have been vaccinated by vaccines financed by ADB. (90.58% of outcome target). Data is disaggregated. Data Source: Integrated health management information system, digital immunization management unit, and MOHP project progress reports.
